key_insight: Adding unbalanced optimal-transport regularization to a Diffusion Transformer improves probabilistic limit-order volume forecasts by jointly accounting for price placement and total volume.
engineering_relevance: This is financial-market forecasting research, not materials discovery, but its geometry-aware treatment of unnormalized fields may inform other engineering prediction tasks.
method: Condition a Diffusion Transformer on the current order book and recent order flow.
Predict unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields over the next five minutes using an auxiliary unbalanced optimal-transport loss.
Evaluate full-field forecasts with transport costs, proper scoring rules, and calibration diagnostics.
evidence_signal: Across 1,950 validation conditions covering 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduced full-field transport cost by 45.8% and transport energy score by 26.1% versus MSE-only training, with both metrics improving for every stock.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish generalization beyond the evaluated equities and five-minute horizon or quantify deployment costs.
paper_title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
